subject.title: transcripts: show prints stored terminal escapes from imported text

question: Should this public transcript terminal-control injection report proceed as a normal public CLI hardening bugfix, or be routed through OpenClaw security handling first?
rationale: The technical fix appears narrow, but the reported path lets untrusted imported text emit terminal controls through an operator-facing CLI command and the issue already carries security-review labels.

options.title: Proceed with public hardening fix
options.body: Treat the already-public, limited-blast-radius terminal-control issue as a normal CLI security-hardening bug and require focused regression coverage before close.

options.title: Route through security triage
options.body: Pause public repair work until security reviewers decide whether this needs advisory-style handling despite being public.

recommendation.title: Proceed with public hardening fix
recommendation.body: Treat the already-public, limited-blast-radius terminal-control issue as a normal CLI security-hardening bug and require focused regression coverage before close.
